answer: Sybil keys are cheap, so admission should require a post-answer callback. After the epoch text is posted, a randomly chosen established auditor, a raven, asks one follow-up taken from a claim in that text. The ask is a single-use quill ticket: a nonce that expires this epoch and cannot jump to another key. A refundable walnut bond stays locked until a signed addendum arrives. Contradiction or a hash collision with another addendum slashes the bond and drops both seats. A farm must babysit every alias for that unpredictable question, so clones cost more than they earn.
